features.zh: 账号设置支持改密、注销和修改用户名，操作按需展开；统一图标、衬线标题与按钮层次，精简留言操作；关于页新增运行天数滚动计数。
features.en: Expandable account controls, consistent icons and serif headings, clearer action buttons and compact guestbook controls; an animated site uptime counter on the About page.

features.zh: 书库首页直达分类、搜索和书架；搜索固定显示五项候选，支持列表内滚动，出处以标签展示。
features.en: A compact library entrance with five visible, scrollable search suggestions and framed source labels.

features.zh: 选书新增跟随鼠标的圆环与点击动效；手机导航仅保留投稿图标，书架滚动取消吸附。
features.en: An animated book cursor, an icon-only mobile submission link, and free-scrolling mobile shelves.

features.zh: 收藏移到阅读工具右侧，邮箱支持一键复制；品牌与打赏提示使用统一纸面样式，捎信在展开支付方式后出现。
features.en: Favorites sit beside reading controls; email can be copied; brand and support tooltips use the paper style, and private notes appear after payment options.

features.zh: 书封新增英文标题、更多配色和实体细节；封面下方书名随界面语言切换，手机横滑可浏览全部书籍。
features.en: Refined book materials and colors, English cover titles, localized book names below covers, and complete mobile shelves.

features.zh: 书库内搜索支持候选；投稿独立到顶部导航，表单简化为文字和可选链接。
features.en: Search suggestions in the library; a dedicated submission page with a text field and an optional link.

features.zh: 留言支持回复；注册可选择邀请码或申请；支持支付宝和私密捎信；关于页补充技术架构。
features.en: Guestbook replies, invite-or-application registration, Alipay, private notes and a technical architecture overview.
